page.layout: One page of text: a centred heading and a table of Greek verb forms. Row labels stand at the left of each group, and the forms run in three columns to the right. Running head at the top; page number 192 at the head left.
page.notes: The Greek forms are set in a worn, ornamental type and many accents and final letters are doubtful; the Greek readings are best checked against the scan. The row labels Do,uel dor., Perfectu., Infinitu 1., Infinitu 2., Futuru 1. and Dauelrc. are printed in the left margin of the table, as are the small marks at the foot right ("δί-"), which is a catchword-like fragment and is left out. The top-left corner shows show-through from the reverse side and is not transcribed.
